name: Awareness
overview: Scripture reveals that true awareness begins with God revealing Himself to us, as seen when the LORD appeared to Abraham (Genesis 18:1) and when the psalmist prays for open eyes to behold God's law (Psalms 119:18). Prophetic visions, like Isaiah’s, show that spiritual insight is granted by God to understand His purposes (Isaiah 1:1). Ultimately, awareness of God's glory and love fills the earth and leads to salvation through faith in Christ (Habakkuk 2:14; John 3:16), highlighting that self-awareness and knowledge of God are inseparable in the believer’s journey.
